# EIRVAN

> EIRVAN (eirvan.com) is an independent multi-niche digital publication covering Technology, Business, Lifestyle, Education, and News with cited primary sources.

## Canonical Category Hubs
- [Technology](https://eirvan.com/category/technology): Investigative technical briefings examining neuromorphic architectures, co-packaged optical interconnects, wafer lithography, and sub-milliwatt edge intelligence.
- [Business](https://eirvan.com/category/business): Analytical coverage of algorithmic execution, off-exchange crossing networks, FPGA order matching, institutional liquidity, and sovereign capital allocation.
- [Lifestyle](https://eirvan.com/category/lifestyle): Evidence-led reporting on human clinical trials, mitochondrial coenzymes, epigenetic methylation, and sleep-circadian alignment grounded in registered trials.
- [Education](https://eirvan.com/category/education): Research-backed methodologies on attention conservation, ultradian sprint architecture, mesolimbic motivation calibration, and technical skill acquisition.
- [News](https://eirvan.com/category/news): Timely news reporting on global semiconductor capacity expansions, market settlement reforms, AI safety governance, and scientific institutional milestones.
